description: This PHP source file contains code for testing Jira SOAP interface integration within the TestLink project. It includes configuration setup, external dependencies, class instantiations, and test method calls related to Jira issue management.

classes.name: tlIssueTracker
classes.description: Class responsible for managing issue tracking via external systems, instantiated with database connection.

classes.name: jirasoapInterface
classes.description: Class providing SOAP interface methods to interact with Jira issues, including connection, retrieval, and creation.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Method to retrieve available issue types from the issue tracker.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the SOAP interface is successfully connected to Jira.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific Jira issue by its key.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new Jira issue with provided summary and description.
